question: Read the attached Software License Agreement. Where is Customer Data stored, and under what conditions (if any) may it be processed elsewhere?
expected_answer: Customer Data is stored in eu-west-1, with disaster-recovery processing permitted in us-west-2 ONLY with written consent.
forbidden_answers: Customer Data is stored in eu-west-1.
